checks.details: Requirement 1.1: New window creation via Cmd+Shift+N. Menu.ts registers accelerator CmdOrCtrl+Shift+N calling WindowManager.createWindow(). WindowManager.createWindow() creates a BrowserWindow with project selection screen (projectPath: null). E2E test in multi-window-creation.e2e.spec.ts validates creation.

Requirement 1.2: Window tRPC context binding on project selection. WindowManager.setWindowProject() stores projectPath per window. WindowContextFactory resolves event.sender to window and creates per-window context with getCurrentProjectPath closure. selectProject() in projectSetup.ts calls wm.setWindowProject().

Requirement 1.3: Per-window tRPC procedure execution. WindowContextFactory creates per-request context from event.sender -> BrowserWindow -> WindowManager.getWindowContext(). getCurrentProjectPath and getSpecManagerService are closure-bound per window.

Requirement 1.4: Project context isolation between windows. WindowManager stores per-window state in Map structures (windowStates, windowServices). Setting project B on window B does not affect window A. E2E test verifies independent registration.

Requirement 1.5: File watcher cleanup on window close. handleWindowClose() stops specsWatcherService, agentRecordWatcherService, bugsWatcherService, and resets autoExecutionCoordinator. WindowServices are deleted from the Map.

Requirement 1.6: macOS behavior when last window closes. index.ts handles 'window-all-closed' event: non-darwin quits, darwin keeps running. 'activate' event creates new window via WindowManager if no windows exist.

Requirement 2.1: windowFactory.ts abolished, WindowManager manages all windows via Map. windowFactory.ts is deleted (confirmed by git status 'D' and glob returning no results). WindowManager uses Map<number, WindowState> for all window management.

Requirement 2.2: app.whenReady() creates window via WindowManager. index.ts uses windowManager.restoreWindows() which creates default window if no saved states, then initializeTRPCHandler with WindowManager.
Requirement 2.3: app.on('activate') delegates to WindowManager. index.ts activate handler checks windowManager.getAllWindowIds() and creates window via windowManager.createWindow() if empty.

Requirement 2.4: second-instance handling via WindowManager. index.ts second-instance handler uses windowManager.getWindowByProject() for duplicate check, restoreAndFocus for existing windows, and creates new window for new projects.

Requirement 2.5: Window title shows 'SDD Orchestrator - {project name}'. WindowManager.setWindowProject() extracts project name and sets title. Default title 'SDD Orchestrator' shown for windows without project.

Requirement 3.1: setupTRPCHandler with per-window context factory. initializeTRPCHandler() uses createWindowContextFactory() as the createContext for createIPCHandler. Singleton IPCHandler pattern (DD-001) with attachWindow for subsequent windows.
Requirement 3.2: getCurrentProjectPath() returns request-originating window's project. WindowContextFactory overrides getCurrentProjectPath with closure bound to windowContext.projectPath.

Requirement 3.3: getSpecManagerService() returns request-originating window's instance. WindowContextFactory overrides getSpecManagerService with closure bound to per-window services.specManagerService.

Requirement 3.4: projectState.ts global variables replaced with WindowManager delegation. getCurrentProjectPath() delegates to WindowManager.getFocusedWindowId() -> getWindowProject(). Setters are deprecated no-ops.

Requirement 3.5: selectProject() initializes only the target window's services. selectProject() in projectSetup.ts accepts optional windowId, calls wm.setWindowProject() which calls createWindowServices() for that specific window only.

Requirement 3.6: Context/service cleanup on window close. handleWindowClose() removes windowServices, windowStates, projectWindowMap entries, and webContentsToWindowId mapping. IPCHandler.detachWindow is called.

Requirement 4.1: EventBus events include projectPath metadata. Events emitted in projectSetup.ts and watcherUtils.ts include projectPath. EventBusFilter defines PROJECT_SCOPED_EVENTS (22 events) and APP_SCOPED_EVENTS (14 events).

Requirement 4.2: tRPC Subscription filters events by window context. createEventSubscription() in events.ts uses shouldDeliverEvent() to compare event projectPath with window's getCurrentProjectPath(). Non-matching events are dropped.

Requirement 4.3: Project-scoped events not delivered to unrelated windows. shouldDeliverEvent() returns false when eventProjectPath != windowProjectPath for project-scoped events. isProjectScopedEvent() uses O(1) Set lookup.
Requirement 4.4: App-scoped events broadcast to all windows. shouldDeliverEvent() returns true for non-project-scoped events (settings changes, Remote UI status, SSH status, MCP status, etc.).

Requirement 4.5: Subscription listener cleanup on window close. createEventSubscription() returns cleanup function that calls eventBus.removeListener(). When BrowserWindow closes, electron-trpc triggers unsubscribe automatically.

Requirement 5.1: Duplicate project detection focuses existing window. WindowManager.setWindowProject() returns DUPLICATE_PROJECT error. selectProject() in projectSetup.ts detects this and calls wm.restoreAndFocus(error.existingWindowId). E2E test verifies.
Requirement 5.2: Minimized window restored on duplicate. WindowManager.restoreAndFocus() checks isMinimized() and calls restore() before focus().
Requirement 5.3: Path normalization with trailing slash removal and symlink resolution. normalizePath() uses realpathSync for symlink resolution and replace(/\/+$/, '') for trailing slashes.

Requirement 5.4: --project CLI arg and second-instance duplicate detection. second-instance handler in index.ts uses windowManager.getWindowByProject() and restoreAndFocus() for existing project windows.

Requirement 6.1: Menu context updates on window focus. initializeMenuFocusTracking() is implemented in menu.ts (line 371) and is called from index.ts (line 287) after createMenu() (line 284) during app startup. This registers a WindowManager.onWindowFocus callback that calls setMenuProjectPath() with the focused window's project path. [RE-INSPECTION: Previously PARTIAL because call was missing from startup code; now FIXED with initializeMenuFocusTracking() called at index.ts:287]

Requirement 6.2: Project-specific menu items disabled when no project. Menu items use 'enabled: currentProjectPathForMenu !== null' to disable when no project is selected. setMenuProjectPath(null) disables them.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/main/menu.ts:222 (enabled: currentProjectPathForMenu !== null for layout reset)

checks.details: Requirement 6.3: Recent projects menu opens in project-less window or creates new. buildRecentProjectsSubmenu() calls findProjectlessWindow() first, then falls back to wm.createWindow() via WindowManager.
Requirement 6.4: 'New window' menu uses WindowManager. Menu item with CmdOrCtrl+Shift+N calls getWindowManager().createWindow().

Requirement 7.1: Window state persistence on app quit. cleanupOnQuit() in appLifecycle.ts calls windowManager.saveAllWindowStates() which saves position, size, projectPath, isMaximized to ConfigStore via setMultiWindowStates().

Requirement 7.2: Window state restoration on startup. index.ts calls windowManager.restoreWindows() which reads saved states from configStore.getMultiWindowStates() and creates windows with saved bounds, project paths, and maximized states.
Requirement 7.3: Non-existent project directory skipped with logging. restoreWindows() checks existsSync(state.projectPath) and skips with logger.warn if missing.
Requirement 7.4: Default window on first launch. restoreWindows() creates a default window when restored === 0 (no saved states or all projects missing).
Requirement 7.5: Multi-display fallback to primary display. validateDisplayBounds() checks if bounds are within any display and falls back to primary display workArea if off-screen.

Requirement 8.1: E2E test for multi-window creation and independent project operation. multi-window-creation.e2e.spec.ts covers window creation, independent project registration, window title verification, and spec list independence.

Requirement 8.2: E2E test for duplicate project prevention with focus behavior. multi-window-duplicate-prevention.e2e.spec.ts covers DUPLICATE_PROJECT error, checkDuplicate, restoreAndFocus, minimized window restore, and path normalization.

Requirement 8.3: E2E test for per-window tRPC operations. multi-window-trpc.e2e.spec.ts covers window context resolution, webContentsToWindowId mapping, per-window services isolation, and spec list independence.

Requirement 8.4: E2E test for window close resource cleanup. multi-window-cleanup.e2e.spec.ts covers PerWindowServices removal, WindowState removal, duplicate lock release, webContentsToWindowId cleanup, and primary window resilience.
